request:
Implement m3a-002 in this real Tokage repository: reduce redundant scroll-observer lifecycle work in SessionHistoryView while preserving the m3a-001 reading behavior. Current scroll effect depends on visibleLogs (fresh snapshots and transcriptRows arrays), recreating ResizeObserver on each render/update. Meet the preregistered acceptance below. Add meaningful rendered React/happy-dom tests; keep all existing tests, do not weaken assertions or change build configuration. Do not edit files outside write_scope, even transiently. Do not edit .tokage, reliability docs, runner, model/auth/DB or package files. Use the already installed dev dependencies. Run npm ci --ignore-scripts --offline --no-audit --no-fund, npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run check:i18n and npm run build. Native sandbox only permits workspace writes: create ignored src-tauri/target/m3a-tmp and set TMPDIR="$PWD/src-tauri/target/m3a-tmp" for test/build commands. Do not write HOME or system temp. Tokage records delivery commits; do not commit yourself. Report under the required TaskReport headings, deviations None if none. External desktop streaming validation is performed independently after delivery; do not claim it already passed.

Preregistered acceptance:
For one selected attempt, at least 100 successive rendered transcript updates create at most one ResizeObserver subscription; content growth is still observed. Measure construction/disconnection counts in a rendered DOM test, not just a helper mock.
Selection change and unmount disconnect obsolete observers; queued callbacks after cleanup cannot scroll or alter the newly selected attempt. Cover cleanup and stale callbacks with DOM tests.
Preserve initial latest position, bottom following, scrolled-up reading position, keyboard-accessible return-to-latest, attempt reset, empty/loading/error/end behavior, and message spacing. Keep all m3a-001 regressions passing.
Typecheck, all frontend tests, i18n validation and production build pass. No runtime dependencies, package/build configuration, auth, database or model routing changes.
Independent review before desktop merge. Build delivered source and repeat real GPT6 Luna stream geometry plus durable DONE validation. This requirement counts once, preserving any failures or external rescue.

Independent review findings from the previous attempt (original acceptance is unchanged):
Independent review of m3a-002 attempt 1. The original request, write scope, acceptance and fixed Luna model remain unchanged. No business code was edited by the reviewer.

1. The task explicitly required retaining all m3a-001 regression coverage. The six previous view tests were replaced with two lifecycle tests, reducing the whole suite from 328 to 324. Restore the six existing behavioral regressions and add lifecycle coverage alongside them; do not weaken their assertions.
2. The stale-callback test selects the first element matching overflow-y-auto, which is the LEFT navigation tree, not the RIGHT transcript container captured by the observer. Its scrollTop assertion can pass even when the obsolete callback still mutates the actual transcript. Test the real transcript after switching to another attempt and after unmount. Also confirm that the 100 updates actually render changing transcript content, and exercise a real controlled content-height growth callback and preserved reading intent.
3. The new MutationObserver observes every added element and all descendants, but never unobserves removed elements. A long-running transcript with replaced/collapsed tool subtrees can retain detached nodes in a persistent ResizeObserver, an unintended memory regression for this performance change. Ensure the lifecycle does not retain removed transcript targets; cover target removal/cleanup in a meaningful DOM regression. This is review of a newly introduced regression, not a relaxation or expansion of the original feature scope.

All preregistered gates and external real Luna desktop verification are still required. Do not edit Vite configuration, package files, scope/security policy or acceptance infrastructure. The provided workspace cache and TMPDIR remain available.

Environment repaired and independently verified: each worktree receives an independent writable npm cache at src-tauri/target/m3a-npm-cache. Use npm --cache ./src-tauri/target/m3a-npm-cache for installs, with --offline --ignore-scripts; happy-dom@21.0.3 and this project dependencies are seeded. For test commands, create src-tauri/target/m3a-tmp and set TMPDIR="$PWD/src-tauri/target/m3a-tmp". These paths are already ignored. Do not write HOME or relax sandbox policy. Actually render SessionHistoryView in a DOM regression; do not replace this with EventTarget-only tests or omit tests because the previous shared cache failed.
